sub_service: Water emergencies, leakage, contamination, tanker supply, sewerage blockage
problem_type: No/low water supply, leakage, contaminated water, sewerage blockage
authority: Junior Engineer at the nearest of DJB's 25 Water Emergencies (first level)
description: DJB's published grievance-redressal mechanism runs 3 levels: 25 zonally-located Water Emergencies (Junior Engineer / Zonal Engineer / Executive Engineer) as first contact; a Central Control Room (CCR) monitoring all 25, reachable on hotline 1916; and automatic escalation to the Public Grievance Commission (PGC) if a complaint posted on the CM's 'Aap Ki Sunwai' portal gets no action from the responsible official within 21 days.
procedure: Report to the nearest Water Emergency (in person/phone) or call the CCR hotline 1916 / SMS 54646 with a category code (W=water, L=leakage, B=blockage, C=contamination, T=tanker, M=manhole, R=rainwater, MT=meter, BL=billing). If unresolved and posted via CM's Aap Ki Sunwai portal, the Public Grievance Commission takes it up suo moto after 21 days.
sla: Complaints received at the CCR are transferred to the concerned Water Emergency within 1 hour for action. PGC auto-escalation after 21 days of no action on a portal-posted complaint.
expected_resolution_time: SLA NOT FOUND for on-ground repair completion -- only the 1-hour handoff and 21-day PGC-escalation trigger are published on this page.
complaint_channel: CM's Aap Ki Sunwai portal (also phone 155345)
Police Control Room hotline (routed through CCR)
escalation_procedure: Level 1: zonal Water Emergency (JE/Zonal Engineer/Executive Engineer). Level 2: Central Control Room (hotline 1916). Level 3: Public Grievance Commission, auto-triggered after 21 days of no action on a CM's Aap Ki Sunwai complaint.
source_title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism — Delhi Jal Board

sub_service: Pothole/road damage complaints, streetlight repair, general infrastructure complaints on PWD roads
problem_type: Potholes, damaged road, streetlight not working (on roads under Delhi PWD's jurisdiction)
municipality: Public Works Department (PWD), Government of NCT of Delhi
description: Delhi PWD's Citizen Charter publishes general (not category-specific) complaint-handling commitments applying to the roads and streetlights it maintains, alongside a real toll-free helpline, WhatsApp line, and the PWD Sewa mobile app/portal for submission and status tracking. Delhi's road network is split across PWD, MCD, and NHAI/state highways depending on road classification -- this record covers PWD-maintained roads specifically, not the whole city.
procedure: Submit via the PWD Sewa portal/app or call the toll-free helpline; a written complaint is acknowledged within a week, with an interim reply on progress within a month where feasible.
sla: Routine complaints: attended within 24 hours. Written requests/complaints: acknowledged within 1 week of receipt, followed by an interim progress reply within 1 month wherever feasible/possible.
expected_resolution_time: SLA NOT FOUND for a specific completion timeline -- only the 24-hour attend / 1-week acknowledge / 1-month interim-reply commitments are published.
contact_information: Toll-free 1908; phone 23490323; WhatsApp +91-8130188222; Main Office: 12th Floor, MSO Building, IP Estate, New Delhi – 110002; email dspwddelhi@gmail.com.
escalation_procedure: SLA NOT FOUND on this page -- no multi-level escalation ladder is published, only the acknowledgement/interim-reply commitments above.
source_title: Citizen Charter — Public Works Department, Government of NCT of Delhi

procedure: Call the Citizen's Call Center or file via the MCD311 mobile app; complaints are routed to the relevant zone/department.

service_name: Community/Public Toilet Complaint Resolution (Swachh Bharat Mission SLB)
sub_service: Complaints, maintenance issues, or incidents at community/public toilets (CTs/PTs)
problem_type: Non-functional or unmaintained community/public toilet facility, related maintenance issues or incidents
department: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Swachh Bharat Mission
authority: Area Sanitary Inspector / toilet supervisor and supervisor's agency
description: MCD's Service Level Benchmarking (SLB) handbook, published under Swachh Bharat Mission, sets a specific, numeric complaint-resolution commitment for community and public toilets (CTs/PTs): 'Complaint registration and redressal mechanism is in place and functioning, all complaints, maintenance issues or incidents must be resolved within 24 hours.' This is scoped specifically to community/public toilet facilities under the SLB monitoring framework, not to general household garbage collection (see DL_MCD_WASTE_GRIEVANCE_CHANNEL for that, which remains SLA NOT FOUND) -- the two records cover genuinely different services and should not be conflated. The document also requires contact information of the supervisor, supervisor's agency, and area Sanitary Inspector to be prominently displayed at each toilet.
procedure: Contact information for the toilet's supervisor, supervisor's agency, and area Sanitary Inspector is required to be displayed at the facility itself; complaints are registered through the toilet's own posted complaint mechanism.
sla: All complaints, maintenance issues, or incidents at community/public toilets must be resolved within 24 hours (per MCD's SLB monitoring guideline, item 20).
expected_response_time: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE -- only a single combined 24-hour resolution commitment is published, not a separate response/acknowledgement time.
expected_resolution_time: 24 hours (from the SLB monitoring guideline's own wording: 'must be resolved within 24 hours').
complaint_channel: Complaint mechanism posted on-site at each community/public toilet (per the SLB requirement)
Nodal Officer (MCD Swachh Survekshan): Kumar Abhishek, mcdswachhsurvekshan@gmail.com
contact_information: Nodal Officer (MCD Swachh Survekshan cell): Kumar Abhishek, mcdswachhsurvekshan@gmail.com. On-site: area Sanitary Inspector (contact displayed at each toilet).
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE -- the document names the MCD Commissioner and zonal Deputy Commissioners as the SLB performance-verification/guidance chain, but does not publish a citizen-facing escalation ladder for an unresolved toilet complaint specifically.
escalation_authority: MCD Commissioner / zonal Deputy Commissioner (SLB performance oversight, not a stated citizen escalation channel)
